layout.title: Set up HeoPress with full controls
layout.description: Use the full wizard when you want to tune admin path, security policy, project identity, and recovery settings one screen at a time.

path.label: Path
path.description: Pick a private URL for the Studio admin surface.

security.description: Configure login lockout and anomaly detection.

project.description: Set language, site URL, title, and theme direction.

recovery.description: Save backup codes for emergency access.

done.label: Done
done.description: Setup complete — bookmark your admin URL.

wizard.title: Set up HeoPress in 3 steps
wizard.description: The quick path applies the same production defaults as the full wizard. Before anything is created, the review step lists every default that will be applied.
wizard.presetInvalid: The selected security preset is invalid.
wizard.badResponse: Setup completed, but the response shape was unexpected.

presetDescriptions.strict: Tighter lockouts and all anomaly checks.
presetDescriptions.lenient: Lower-friction lockouts for private dev instances.
presetDescriptions.standard: Recommended defaults for new production projects.

essentials.title: Account and admin URL
essentials.description: These are the setup values that cannot be inferred safely. Project identity uses HeoPress defaults in quick setup and can be tuned in Advanced setup.
essentials.adminPathHelp: Bookmark this URL after setup. It replaces the predictable /admin path.

review.title: Review what quick setup will apply
review.description: Nothing has been written yet. Switch to advanced setup now if you want to tune individual lockout, anomaly, or notification fields.
review.advancedBody: Quick setup lists every hidden default here. Use Advanced setup when you need custom webhook notifications, anomaly thresholds, or exact lockout windows before the first admin account is created.

invites.title: Invite teammates (optional)
invites.description: They're added as invited users and appear under Users after they sign in. You can also do this later.

recovery.description: These codes are shown once. Save them before opening the admin login.

recovery.invited_other: {{count}} teammates invited — they'll appear under Users after they sign in.
recovery.confirm: I have saved these backup codes and my private admin path.

project.title: Configure your project
project.description: Set the default identity for this HeoPress project. Theme customization is visible here as a preview and will unlock in a future release.

language.label: Default language
language.help: Use a language tag such as en, vi, or en-US.

displayTitle.label: Display title
displayTitle.help: Shown in Studio and project metadata.

siteUrl.label: Site URL
siteUrl.help: Canonical public URL used for metadata and future links.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Horizon preview. Theme customization is coming in a future release.
theme.horizonDescription: Luminous surfaces, warm orange actions, and soft glass-like depth.

done.title: Setup complete
done.description: Your HeoPress instance is initialised. Save the admin URL below before navigating away.
done.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy automatically. Select the path above and copy it manually.
done.bookmark: Save this URL as a bookmark. Without it, you’ll need to run the recovery flow with one of your backup codes.
done.invalidPath: The saved admin path is invalid. Run setup again before using this instance.

noSetup.title: No setup in progress
noSetup.body: We couldn’t find a completed setup in this browser session. Start the wizard from the beginning to configure your instance.

path.generateFailed: Couldn't generate a unique path. Try again or enter one manually.
path.title: Choose a private admin path
path.description: Pick a URL slug that bots won’t guess. The Studio will only respond at this path; everything else returns 404.
path.label: Admin path
path.help: Use lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens. 4–64 characters after the leading slash.
path.warningBody: Losing it means running the recovery flow with one of your backup codes. Bookmark the URL, store it in your password manager, or write it down somewhere safe before continuing.
path.confirm: I have saved my admin path. I understand losing it requires the recovery flow.

recovery.fileHeader: HeoPress backup codes — store securely. Each code works once.
recovery.title: Save your recovery codes
recovery.description: Save these recovery codes. Each can be used once to regain access if you’re locked out. They won’t be shown again.
recovery.downloadLabel: Download backup codes as a text file
recovery.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy automatically. Select the codes above and copy them manually, or use Download .txt.
recovery.storeSafely: Store these somewhere safe and offline — a password manager or a printout. Without them (or your admin path) you’ll need the email recovery flow to get back in.
recovery.confirm: I have saved these backup codes

noCodes.title: No backup codes to display
noCodes.body: Your recovery codes are shown only once, right after setup completes, and aren’t stored in this browser. Return to setup to generate a fresh set.

account.title: Create the admin account
account.description: This account becomes the bootstrap administrator for the instance. Pick a strong, unique password — it can’t be reset without recovery codes.
account.tooWeak: Choose a password rated “Strong” or better to continue.

security.title: Configure login security
security.description: Set thresholds for failed login attempts and choose how to be notified about security events.
security.noEncryptionKey: No encryption key is configured on this instance, so two-factor authentication cannot be enrolled and encrypted fields cannot be written. Set {{name}} and restart the CMS — the rest of setup is unaffected.

preset.help: Apply default values to every group below. You can fine-tune after picking a preset.

standard.label: Standard
standard.description: Balanced defaults suitable for most teams.

failed.help: How many failed sign-ins to tolerate before locking a user or blocking an IP.

userMaxFailedAttempts.label: Per-user max attempts
userMaxFailedAttempts.help: Lock a user after this many failed attempts within the window.

userLockoutDurationSeconds.label: User lockout duration (seconds)
userLockoutDurationSeconds.help: How long to keep a user locked.

ipMaxFailedAttempts.label: Per-IP max attempts
ipMaxFailedAttempts.help: Block an IP after this many failed attempts within the window.

ipLockoutDurationSeconds.label: IP lockout duration (seconds)
ipLockoutDurationSeconds.help: How long to keep an IP blocked.

lockoutWindowSeconds.label: Sliding window (seconds)
lockoutWindowSeconds.help: Counter window for tallying failed attempts.

geo.help: Flag sign-ins from countries the user hasn't logged in from before.
geo.unavailable: GeoIP database is unavailable on this instance; geographic anomaly detection will stay off until you install it.

time.help: Flag sign-ins at hours the user rarely logs in.

device.help: Flag sign-ins from a User-Agent or device fingerprint the user hasn't used before.

action.help: What the system should do when a sign-in's anomaly score crosses the threshold.
action.thresholdHelp: Range 0.00–1.00 with two decimal places. Default 0.70.
action.label: Action
action.mfaUnavailable: MFA module is not installed; the "Require MFA" option is unavailable for now.

notify.help: Where to send security event notifications. At least one channel must be selected.
notify.webhookUrlHelp: HTTPS endpoint that will receive security event POSTs.
notify.webhookSecretHelp: Used to sign webhook payloads with HMAC-SHA256. Keep this safe.
